COLUMN 00/12 · LEFT MARGIN
The object is the explanation. A key stroke pivots a typebar into the ink ribbon and paper, while the escapement meters the carriage one character at a time. SPACE feeds without printing; RETURN releases the rack and brings the carriage home.
